hero.title: The Perfect Venue for Your Special Moments
hero.text: A grand, beautifully lit convention hall in the heart of Aurad – for weddings, receptions, engagements, naming ceremonies, corporate events and every celebration in between.

about.intro: Nirmale Convention Hall, also known as Nirmale Function Hall, is Aurad's elegant function hall and marriage hall for life's biggest celebrations. From the moment guests arrive at our illuminated façade to the instant the couple steps onto a flower-filled stage, every space is designed to feel grand, welcoming and unforgettable.
about.story: Built by the Nirmale family with a simple promise – that every family in Aurad and the surrounding villages deserves a dignified, beautiful venue close to home – the hall brings together a modern multi-storey building, a spacious function hall and a stage that transforms for every occasion. Whether it is a traditional wedding with hundreds of relatives, an intimate haldi, a naming ceremony or a company gathering, our team works with you on décor, lighting, seating and arrangements so you can simply enjoy the day.
about.vision: To be the most trusted celebration venue in the Bidar district – a place where families feel at home, guests feel honoured, and every event is remembered for its beauty and warmth.

team.name: Mr. Jaganath Nirmale
team.bio: Mr. Jaganath Nirmale is the vision behind Nirmale Convention Hall. A respected name in Aurad, he built the hall so that families of the region could celebrate their most important days in a grand, modern venue without travelling to the city. He believes in transparent pricing, warm hospitality and treating every guest's function like a celebration in his own family.
team.quote: Every celebration that happens here carries our family's name. We make sure it is one you are proud of.
team.summary: The founder and vision behind Nirmale Convention Hall – he built a grand, modern venue so families of Aurad can celebrate their biggest days close to home.

team.name: Mr. Rahul G. Kade
team.bio: Mr. Rahul G. Kade manages the hall's day-to-day operations and is your first point of contact – from the first site visit and checking dates, to coordinating décor, lighting, sound and seating on the day of your event. Known for quick responses and close attention to detail, he makes planning simple and stress-free for every family and organiser.
team.quote: Tell us how you imagine your day – we will take care of the arrangements.
highlights: On-site support on your event day
team.summary: Manages the hall day to day and is your first point of contact – from site visits and checking dates to coordinating every arrangement on your event day.
